Digital Creativity I · I.6 Volume

Recall check

Answer from memory, then check the ideas in the lesson.

  1. What can a side view show that the front view hides?
  2. Name one possible mismatch between cloth and simulation.
  3. What will you hold constant when comparing two passes?
  4. What evidence makes a revision legible?
  5. Why does a polished render not prove material behaviour by itself?

Course geometric background · threshold · #c378606cc29b · Original course SVG

Answer cues: depth profile; drape/tension/fold; keep scale and viewpoint constant; before/after pair with changed region marked; a final image alone does not verify support, gravity, or material.

Digital Creativity I · I.6 Volume

Exercise 1 · Build one fold

Build a small volume from paper, cloth, or another available material; photograph two views and mark where the fold changes.

Build only enough volume to test one fold.

(Tao of the Image)

Two views and one note on the changed contour, support, or drape.
